# ADR-3044: A04: Shared mutable cache key for tenant 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Key collisions leak or clobber tenant data.

## Decision

Caches MUST NOT use a shared mutable cache key for tenant 8 (A04-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Keys include tenant and object identity.
